title: Senior Manager - Linux Unix HPC Computing
description:
Work Your Magic with us!

  

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

 **Senior Manager – Linux Unix HPC Computing**


We are seeking an experienced **Senior Manager – Linux/Unix \& HPC Computing** to lead a team of senior engineers and architects responsible for enterprise infrastructure across on\-premises data centers and cloud environments.


This role combines technical leadership, infrastructure strategy, people management, operational excellence, and technology transformation. The successful candidate will be accountable for developing and operating secure, highly available, resilient, automated, and cost\-effective infrastructure platforms that support critical business needs.


The role will be based in Bangalore, India.

**Your Role:**

* Lead the engineering, operations, modernization, and lifecycle management of enterprise Linux/Unix, high\-performance computing (HPC), cloud, containerization, clustered storage, and data center infrastructure.
* Define and implement enterprise standards for configuration management, automation, orchestration, Infrastructure as Code, monitoring, observability, and self\-service capabilities.
* Establish and maintain high\-availability, disaster recovery, business continuity, backup, and resilience strategies for critical infrastructure services.
* Own patch management, vulnerability remediation, configuration compliance, security hardening, and technology lifecycle management across infrastructure platforms.
* Drive infrastructure standardization, automation, proactive capacity planning, reliability improvements, and the reduction of technical debt and operational complexity.
* Manage infrastructure software licensing, asset lifecycles, vendor relationships, support agreements, contracts, renewals, service\-level agreements, and related commercial activities in collaboration with Procurement and Finance.
* Partner closely with Security, Network, Storage, Cloud, Application, Architecture, Service Management, and other technology teams to deliver integrated infrastructure solutions and enterprise\-wide initiatives.
* Lead major infrastructure projects, technology assessments, migrations, upgrades, data center initiatives, and transformation programs.
* Provide technical leadership during complex incidents, ensuring timely resolution, thorough root\-cause analysis, effective remediation, and continuous improvement.
* Develop and execute infrastructure roadmaps aligned with business strategy, technology standards, security requirements, operational priorities, and cost objectives.
* Lead, mentor, and develop senior engineers and architects while fostering a culture of technical excellence, automation, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a trusted technology partner to senior stakeholders, translating business requirements into scalable, reliable, secure, and sustainable infrastructure solutions.

**Who You Are:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree, or an equivalent qualification, in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 10–15 years of experience in enterprise Linux/Unix systems, high\-performance computing, configuration management, orchestration, integration, clustered enterprise storage, cloud computing, Infrastructure as Code, and platform engineering.
* At least 7 years of experience leading teams in an international environment.
* Significant experience leading enterprise infrastructure engineering and operations in complex, large\-scale environments.
* Strong technical expertise in Linux/Unix and enterprise infrastructure platforms, with experience spanning on\-premises data centers and cloud environments.
* Proven experience in configuration management, automation, orchestration, patch management, high availability and disaster recovery, vulnerability management, and infrastructure lifecycle management.
* Experience managing data center infrastructure, vendors, software licensing, contracts, renewals, service\-level agreements, and technology budgets.
* Strong understanding of infrastructure security, reliability, resilience, risk management, and operational governance.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross\-functional initiatives and collaborating effectively with technology and business stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop senior technical professionals.
* Strong strategic thinking, communication, stakeholder management, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to move confidently between detailed technical discussions and senior\-level strategic conversations.

 **What we offer:** We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

  

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

title: System Data Integration Specialist
description:
Req ID: 63059
Job Function: Cloud
Posting Start Date: 23/09/2026
Posting End Date: 29/09/2026
Division: Digital
Job Location: IND\-Bengaluru\-RMZ Ecoworld
Advertised Salary: Competitive
**Recruiter: Sowmya Reddy**

**Hiring Manager: Sajal Goyal**

**Career Grade: D**

**About the role**
------------------

We are seeking an experienced System Integration Specialist with 8\-10 years of expertise in designing, developing and supporting secure enterprise integrations across GCP, AWS and Microsoft Azure environments.

  

The successful candidate will bring strong hands\-on experience in multi\-system integration, cloud connectors, APIs, middleware, microservices and end\-to\-end integration flows, with practical exposure to SAP Cloud Integration (CPI), SAP Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG), EFB, Ab Initio, Kong Konnect and microservices\-based architectures.

  

The role will also support the integration of enterprise applications and data platforms with Large Language Models and GenAI services, ensuring that data exchanged with AI models remains secure, governed, traceable and compliant with enterprise standards.

  

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

1\. Leads cloud system design activities and/or reviews system designs to assure that solutions will exhibit expected levels of performance, security, scalability, security, maintainability, appropriate reusability and reliability upon deployment
  

2\. Manages automation initiatives of cloud infrastructure provisioning and configuration management, self\-service, infrastructure\-as\-code services, auto scale initiatives, and DevOps deployment
  

3\. Communicates with key stakeholders to influence the adoption of cloud\-native systems and helps to inform stakeholders on how to use platform capabilities effectively through appropriate venue
  

4\. Delivers consultative advice through advanced technical knowledge on system architecture and recommend solutions in alignment with systems engineering best practices
  

5\. Leads the collaboration with quality assurance and technical writers to complete development cycle
  

6\. Leads the collaboration with business stakeholders and product owners to scope and de\-risk development activities in advance
  

7\. Executes complex data analyses to make decisions on where to invest and iterate on efficiency and cloud management tools
  

8\. Drives a risk\-aware culture, and ensures efficient and effective risk and compliance management practices by adhering to required standards and processes
  

9\. Ensures efficient functioning of data storage and processing functions in accordance with company security policies and best practices in cloud security
  

10\. Identifies, analyses, and resolves complex infrastructure vulnerabilities and application deployment issues independently
  

11\. Champions, continuously develops and shares with team knowledge on emerging trends and changes in cloud engineering best practices and industry standards
  

12\. Mentors other cloud engineers, helping to improve the team's abilities by acting as a technical resource


**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

**Enterprise and Multi\-System Integration (Must)**

* Design, develop and implement end\-to\-end integrations across enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, ERP systems, data platforms and cloud services.
* Define complete integration flows covering source systems, integration and middleware layers, transformation, orchestration, security, target systems and downstream consumption.
* Integrate heterogeneous systems using APIs, cloud connectors, middleware, event\-driven services, microservices and managed file\-transfer mechanisms.
  

**SAP CPI and CIG (Preferred)**

* Design, build and support integrations using SAP Cloud Integration, formerly CPI, within SAP Integration Suite.
* Configure integration flows, adapters, message mappings, routing, transformations, exception handling and monitoring.
  

**API Management and Kong Konnect (Desirable)**

* Design and implement RESTful APIs and, where relevant, SOAP, GraphQL and webhook\-based interfaces.
* Use Kong Konnect for API gateway, API management, service connectivity and governance requirements.
* Configure API routing, authentication, authorization, rate limiting, throttling, request validation and traffic\-management policies.
  

**Middleware, EFB and Ab Initio (Desirable)**

* Develop and manage integration solutions using enterprise middleware and integration platforms.
* Use EFB capabilities and standards applicable to the organisation’s integration landscape.
* Develop and support Ab Initio graphs, plans and data\-processing workflows for complex data integration requirements.
* Implement data extraction, validation, transformation, enrichment, reconciliation, and loading processes.
* Optimise Ab Initio and middleware workflows for performance, scalability and operational resilience.
  

**Microservices Architecture (Must)**

* Design integration services using microservices and domain\-oriented architecture principles.
* Develop and integrate independently deployable services with clearly defined interface contracts.
* Implement service\-to\-service communication using APIs, messaging and event\-streaming patterns.
* Apply design patterns such as API gateway, circuit breaker, retry and idempotency.
**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

**Essential Experience**

* 8\-10 years of experience in enterprise system integration, middleware, API engineering or cloud integration.
* Strong experience designing complex end\-to\-end integration flows involving multiple source and target systems.
* Hands\-on experience in at least one major cloud platform (GCP or AWS preferred).
* Experience with API management, authentication, authorisation, versioning and lifecycle governance.
  

  

**Technology Experience**

Candidates should possess hands\-on experience or exposure to:


* SAP Cloud Integration (CPI)
* SAP Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG)
* EFB(Enterprise File Broker\-Preferred)
* Ab Initio
* Kong Konnect
* Cloud identity, key\-management and secret\-management services
* Monitoring, logging and observability tools

title: Vended Application Senior Consultant II
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

**Job Description**


The Engineer is a highly experienced individual contributor responsible for delivering scalable, secure, and high\-performance application and AI\-enabled solutions. This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic thinking to translate complex business challenges into robust engineering solutions, including GenAI\-powered and agentic workflows.  

  

As a IC, you will drive technical excellence, influence engineering standards, and lead the design of intelligent systems while collaborating cross\-functionally with product, architecture, and platform teams. You will also play a key role in advancing the organization’s adoption of Generative \& Agentic AI through governance, reusable patterns, and enterprise\-grade integrations. **Key Responsibilities:**

**Engineering**

* Design, develop, and deliver complex, scalable application solutions with a focus on performance, security, and maintainability.
* Own end\-to\-end solution architecture for large features or systems, including microservices, APIs, and event\-driven workflows.
* Lead the design and implementation of reusable components, frameworks, and engineering patterns.
* Ensure high code quality through rigorous testing strategies, code reviews, and adherence to best practices.

* Secure Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, AI Search, and AI workloads through identity, access control, and network security.
* Define and enforce Responsible AI, security, privacy, and governance standards across AI applications.
* Ensure data protection, auditability, compliance, and regulatory adherence for AI\-enabled solutions.

* Conduct security reviews, threat modelling, and vulnerability assessments for AI services and integrations.
* Collaborate with Security Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Governance teams to ensure enterprise\-wide AI security standards.

**GenAI \& Agentic Systems**

* Design and build advanced AI agents capable of reasoning, decision\-making, and tool usage.
* Define when to apply human\-in\-the\-loop vs autonomous agentic patterns.
* Lead the integration of LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, and knowledge bases.

* Establish best practices for prompt engineering, agent design, and reusable AI components.
* Ensure data quality, security, and auditability across AI and application systems.

**Collaboration**

title: Sr. Windows Engineer - Bangalore
description:
Job Description: L2 Lab Server Operator


Work Location: Bangalore


(Systems \& Infrastructure)


Position Overview


We are seeking an experienced L2 Lab Server Operator to manage, maintain, and optimize


our non\-production, R\&D, and testing laboratory environments. In this role, you will be the


backbone of our lab infrastructure, ensuring high availability, performance, and security across a


diverse technical stack.


The ideal candidate possesses deep technical expertise in Wintel (Windows Server),


Enterprise Storage, VMware, and Hyper\-V, alongside a strong engineering mindset to deploy,


troubleshoot, and automate complex lab topologies.

  

  

Key Responsibilities


1\. Compute \& Virtualization Management (VMware \& Hyper\-V)


* Provision \& Maintain: Deploy, configure, and lifecycle\-manage virtual machines across


both VMware vSphere/ESXi and Microsoft Hyper\-V environments.


* Cluster Administration: Manage host clusters, configure high availability (HA),


Distributed Resource Scheduler (DRS), and live migrations (vMotion / Live Migration).


* Resource Optimization: Monitor CPU, memory, and provisioned storage allocation to


prevent resource contention and optimize lab utilization.


* Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve complex Layer 2 virtualization issues, including


host isolation, snapshot chains, and virtual switch (vSwitch) misconfigurations.


2\. Wintel Administration


* OS Lifecycle: Install, configure, and harden Windows Server operating systems (2016


through latest versions) within the lab environment.


* Core Infrastructure Services: Administer and troubleshoot Active Directory (AD), Group


Policy Objects (GPOs), DNS, DHCP, and IIS configurations dedicated to the lab.


* Patch \& Compliance: Implement and maintain a rigorous patching cadence for Windows


servers utilizing WSUS or automated configuration management tools without disrupting


active lab testing.


3\. Enterprise Storage Operations


* Provisioning: Allocate and present storage blocks/shares (SAN/NAS) to virtualization


hosts and standalone bare\-metal servers using protocols like iSCSI, Fibre Channel (FC),


and NFS/SMB.


* Storage Management: Monitor storage array health, capacity, and performance.


Manage storage tiers, deduplication, and snapshots.


* Backup \& Recovery: Execute and verify routine backup configurations for critical lab


baselines, configurations, and data repositories to ensure rapid recovery capabilities.


4\. Lab Operations \& Support

  

* Hardware Lifecycle: Perform physical rack\-and\-stack, cabling (fiber/ethernet), and bare\-


metal provisioning of enterprise servers (e.g., Dell PowerEdge, HPE ProLiant).


* Environment Isolation: Collaborate with networking teams to set up isolated VLANs,


routing, and firewall rules tailored for specific testing scenarios.


* Automation \& Scripting: Leverage PowerShell, PowerCLI, or Python to automate


repetitive tasks such as VM provisioning, environment teardowns, and status reporting.


* Incident Management: Serve as the Tier 2 escalation point for all lab\-related


infrastructure alerts, performance degradation, and hardware failures.

  

  

Qualifications \& Skills


Technical Requirements


* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or


equivalent hands\-on experience.


* Experience: 3–5 years of experience in system administration, infrastructure operations,


or data center environment support.


* Virtualization: Strong proficiency in VMware vSphere (vCenter, ESXi) and Microsoft


Hyper\-V / Failover Cluster Manager.


* Operating Systems: Advanced administration of Windows Server ecosystems; familiarity


with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) or Ubuntu is a plus.


* Storage: Hands\-on experience with enterprise storage platforms (e.g., NetApp, Dell


EMC, Pure Storage) and fabric switches.


* Scripting: Proficiency in PowerShell for Windows and virtualization management.


Soft Skills \& Work Environment


* Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, fluid environment where lab configurations


change frequently based on engineering needs.


* Problem\-Solving: Strong analytical mindset with a methodical approach to root\-cause


analysis.


* Documentation: Diligent about keeping topology diagrams, asset inventories, and "how\-


to" runbooks accurate and up to date.


Preferred Certifications (Any of the following are a plus)


* VMware Certified Professional (VCP)


* Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate


* Enterprise Storage certifications (e.g., NetApp NCA/NCDA, Dell Technologies Associate)

title: Architect,Salesforce
description:
Overview:
**About the company**


Consilio stands as the global leader in eDiscovery, document review, flexible legal talent, and legal advisory \& transformation consulting services. With its Consilio Complete suite of capabilities, the company empowers multinational law firms and corporations using innovative software, cost\-effective managed services, and deep legal and regulatory industry expertise.

* Job Title: Salesforce Architect
* Location: Bangalore, India
* Employment Type: Full\-Time Experience
* Level: 10\+ years
* Benefits: Free pick \& drop,free meals,wifi reimbursements and more
* Shift: 2PM to 11 PM

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Salesforce Architect to join our team in Bangalore. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Salesforce platform architecture, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and the broader Salesforce ecosystem. This role will be responsible for designing scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions by maximizing Salesforce out\-of\-the\-box (OOTB) capabilities and strategically leveraging AppExchange solutions and third\-party plugins to meet business requirements. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, guiding platform strategy, governance, solution architecture, and enterprise\-wide Salesforce adoption.


Responsibilities:

Own and define the Salesforce architecture roadmap, ensuring alignment with enterprise technology and business strategies.  

  

Design scalable solutions leveraging Salesforce OOTB features and capabilities, including Flows, Dynamic Forms, Approval Processes, OmniStudio, Einstein AI, and Platform functionality before considering custom development.  

  

Evaluate, recommend, and implement Salesforce AppExchange applications, managed packages, and third\-party plugins to maximize business value while minimizing technical debt.  

  

Lead architecture and design sessions for Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and future Salesforce platform initiatives.  

  

Establish enterprise integration patterns and oversee integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST APIs, middleware solutions, and event\-driven architectures.  

  

Partner with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Developers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.  

  

Provide architectural leadership, governance, and mentorship to Salesforce Administrators, Developers, and Technical Leads.  

  

Drive platform optimization, security, data architecture, compliance, scalability, and performance best practices.  

  

Review and approve solution designs, ensuring adherence to Salesforce best practices, architectural standards, and long\-term maintainability.  

  

Support release management, environment strategy, and deployment governance in collaboration with DevOps and delivery teams.  

  

Ability to reverse engineer existing platform design and make recommendations to align with SalesForce OOTB best practices and configurations. **Requirements**  

10\+ years of progressive Salesforce experience, including significant experience in solution and platform architecture roles.  

  

Deep expertise across Salesforce platform capabilities, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Salesforce Platform.  

  

Proven experience designing and implementing solutions that maximize Salesforce OOTB functionality and reduce unnecessary customization.  

  

Strong experience evaluating, selecting, and implementing AppExchange applications, managed packages, and third\-party Salesforce ecosystem solutions.  

  

Expert understanding of Salesforce security architecture, sharing models, role hierarchies, permission sets, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements.  

  

Extensive experience designing enterprise integrations using REST APIs, middleware platforms, and integration best practices.  

  

Strong knowledge of Salesforce data architecture, master data management, large data volumes, and platform performance optimization.  

  

Working knowledge of Apex, SOQL, and Lightning Web Components (LWC) sufficient to guide technical design decisions and development teams.  

  

Experience leading technical teams and collaborating with executive stakeholders in Agile/Scrum environments.  

  

Experience in Github, JIRA, Confluence, and CI/CD tools such as Gearset.  

  

Salesforce Application Architect and/or Salesforce System Architect certifications required.  

  

Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) certification is highly preferred.
Qualifications:

Experience leading enterprise\-wide Salesforce transformation initiatives and multi\-cloud implementations.  

  

Knowledge of Salesforce Data Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and AI\-powered Salesforce capabilities.  

  

Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks, governance models, and technology roadmaps.  

  

Experience with integration platforms such as MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or similar technologies.  

  

Experience supporting global Salesforce organizations with complex business processes and large user communities. **Why Join Us:**

* **Be part of a collaborative and innovative work environment.**
* **Opportunity for professional growth and development.**
* **Competitive salary and benefits package.**

description:
**About Us:**  



  

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy and that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world\-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.

 **Target Tech Overview:**


Every time a guest enters a Target store or browses Target.com, they experience the impact of Target’s investments in technology and innovation. We’re the technologists behind one of the most loved retail brands, delivering joy to millions of our guests, team members, and communities.

  

Our global in\-house technology team of more than 5,000 of engineers, data scientists, architects, coaches and product managers strive to make Target the most convenient, safe and joyful place to shop. We use agile practices and leverage open\-source software to adapt and build best\-in\-class technology for our team members and guests—and we do so with a focus on diversity and inclusion, experimentation and continuous learning.

 **Pyramid Overview:**


The Cloud Enablement team builds and operates the foundational public cloud platform that engineering teams across Target rely on to deliver at enterprise scale. Working primarily on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), the team owns a hardened, standardized cloud foundation spanning compute, Kubernetes, storage, networking, and identity — the core building blocks that power Target's digital and data\-driven experiences. Our mission is to make cloud simple, secure, and cost\-effective to consume: we design the opinionated patterns, policies, and guardrails that keep workloads safe and reliable, and we build the APIs, automation, and self\-service tooling that let teams adopt and scale cloud services with confidence. Following an infrastructure\-as\-code philosophy, we treat repeatability, resilience, and security as first\-class engineering outcomes rather than afterthoughts. We partner closely with platform and product teams to onboard new workloads, drive cloud cost stewardship, and continuously raise the bar on operational excellence, availability, and readiness for our highest\-traffic events. As a lead engineer on this team, you'll help shape cloud strategy, architect platform capabilities and tooling, and set technical direction that multiplies the productivity of engineers across the company — a high\-impact role at the center of how Target builds in the cloud.

  

As a Senior Engineer on the Cloud Enablement team, you'll contribute:

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Design, build, deploy, and support scalable cloud platform capabilities using cloud services, preferably **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, with a strong focus on reliability, security, automation, and developer experience in **Golang.**
* Implement cloud engineering best practices across resource provisioning, configuration management, monitoring, observability, security, governance, and cost optimization.
* Develop and maintain cloud infrastructure and platform services using **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** technologies to automate infrastructure deployment and configuration.
* Build and maintain APIs, automation services, and operational tooling that simplify cloud operations and improve engineering productivity.
* Drive continuous improvement by adopting and advancing automation, orchestration, **GitOps, self\-service tooling, and reusable platform patterns**.
* Apply your technical expertise and stay current with emerging technologies and practices across cloud computing, Kubernetes, platform engineering, and DevOps.
* Evaluate new technologies and contribute to technical decision\-making. Initiate and execute research and proof\-of\-concept activities to assess new technologies and approaches.
* Provide technical guidance for both routine and complex engineering challenges, including troubleshooting issues across cloud infrastructure, networking, IAM, CI/CD, observability, monitoring, logging, and tracing. Escalate issues when appropriate.
* Participate in complex design, construction, automation, migration, and implementation initiatives, ensuring solutions meet architectural, security, compliance, and operational requirements.
* Establish and evolve engineering standards and best practices for monitoring, testing, automation, security, and maintenance of cloud platform components, infrastructure services, and shared engineering capabilities.
* Maintain a strong understanding of the organization’s technical capabilities, cloud infrastructure, platform services, and broader technology environment.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Four\-year degree or equivalent practical experience.
* **6\+ years of experience** in software development **(Golang),** cloud engineering **(Google Cloud),** platform engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or infrastructure engineering, with a focus on cloud services.
* Strong domain knowledge of cloud platforms, including **account/project management, compute, storage, databases, networking, serverless technologies, IAM, security, observability, and cost management**.

* Experience developing **APIs, automation, and operational tooling** using **Golang, Python, and Bash scripting**.

* Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with project teams, application teams, partners, and stakeholders.

title: SAP Basis Engineer
description:
Role Description:
**About us**
------------


Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is a global powerhouse in online travel, connecting millions of people with unforgettable experiences in over 220 countries and territories. With a market value of approximately $120 billion and a diverse portfolio of brands such as Booking.com, KAYAK, Priceline, Agoda.com and OpenTable, we’re committed to making it easier to explore everyone to experience the world.


Booking Holdings Bangalore is a cutting\-edge Center of Excellence in Bangalore, India and a key arm of Booking Holdings Inc. Top talent from diverse backgrounds converge here to develop innovative solutions that drive Booking Holdings' brands and business units forward. We offer a vibrant and inclusive workplace that fosters creativity, growth and opportunities to make a real difference on a global scale.

**Business Overview**
---------------------


From bustling cities to remote corners, Booking Holdings' travel brands span 220\+ countries. Our FinTech team powers the financial engine behind this global network. We craft bespoke payment solutions, blending security with scalability. These tools empower our partners, fueling their growth and enhancing traveler experiences. By supporting our partners' success, we strengthen the foundation of our diverse travel ecosystem.

**Role Description**
--------------------


As a SAP Workload Automation and Basis Engineer, you will establish and operate the scheduling and workload automation capability for our Financial Systems. Your primary focus will be SAP workloads, while the capability will also cover connected non\-SAP workloads across on\-premises, cloud and SAP RISE.

  

You will define how jobs and business processes are scheduled, coordinated, monitored and controlled. This includes designing reliable and well performing job chains, establishing safeguards for both the schedule and the systems, creating policies and operational documentation, and enabling AMS partners to execute workloads consistently within clear guardrails.

  

This is a foundational role. You will help build the capability around a new platform. You will create the technical and operational foundations that can scale over time, acquiring central relevance.

  

The role sits within the SAP Basis team. A strong SAP Basis foundation is required, enabling a vertical capability across the technical landscape, system performance, monitoring, business processes, SAP lifecycle roadmap. The role will engage on a daily basis with platform engineers, functional and application teams, aligning scheduling practices with business requirements.

**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Design and establish a robust scheduling and orchestration framework for SAP and connected non\-SAP workloads.
* Define standards for job design, dependencies, calendars, priorities, SLAs, retries, failure handling, reruns and recovery.
* Maintain an inventory of critical jobs, job chains and end\-to\-end financial processes, including ownership, dependencies and operational impact.
* Ensure that scheduling patterns are reliable, auditable, secure and maintainable across SAP, BTP, RISE and cloud AWS, os\-level, on\-prem, third party environments.
* Write and maintain scheduling policies, standards, SoPs, runbooks and operational documentation.
* Establish safeguards for high\-risk workloads, financial close activities, sensitive data flows, conflicting activities and emergency execution.
* Establish auditable quality gates and guardrails providing reliable, efficient, high performing scheduling.
* Define the operating model through which AMS partners execute scheduling and operational requests.
* Convert policies into practical runbooks, checklists, approval requirements and control points that AMS teams can follow consistently.
* Provide independent oversight of execution quality, adherence to policy, incident trends, SLA performance and recurring operational risks.
* Improve the model over time so that governance removes blockers and reduces manual risk without creating unnecessary queues or bureaucracy.
* Contribute to an observability framework that provides visibility into end\-to\-end financial processes, not only individual job outcomes.
* Define meaningful metrics, logs, events, dashboards and alerts for process timeliness, completeness, dependency health and business impact.
* Partner with platform, application and observability teams to connect scheduling signals with incident management and operational response.
* Contribute to incident management, problem management, post\-incident reviews and continuous improvement activities.
* Investigate recurring failures and identify improvements to job design, dependencies, capacity, monitoring, documentation or operating procedures.
* Support change and release planning for scheduling components and critical process chains.
* Ensure appropriate controls for SOx, DORA, NIST\-aligned practices, internal security standards, segregation of duties and auditability.
* Work closely with SAP Basis engineers, application owners, Finance stakeholders, architects, security teams, platform teams and AMS partners.
* Explain technical scheduling and orchestration concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Share knowledge and help build a community of practice around scheduling, orchestration and process observability.
* Help shape the future organization, roles and responsibilities as the capability grows and may evolve into a dedicated team.

**What You’ll Be Bringing**
---------------------------

* 5 to 8 years of experience in workload automation and Basis.
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise job scheduling, batch processing or workload automation in a complex technology environment.
* Experience designing job chains with dependencies, calendars, priorities, SLAs, retries, failure handling and recovery procedures.
* Strong understanding of scheduling and orchestration principles across heterogeneous environments, including SAP and non\-SAP workloads.
* Experience creating operational policies, standards, SoPs, runbooks or similar documentation for technology operations.
* Practical experience working with operations teams, managed service providers or AMS partners through defined processes and controls.
* Strong awareness of observability concepts, including metrics, logs, events, dashboards and alerting.
* Ability to connect technical monitoring with end\-to\-end business or financial processes.
* SAP Basis technical experience, with a good understanding of SAP landscapes, HANA and S/4HANA.
* Goo conceptual knowledge of Linux, databases and networking.
* Scripting or automation experience, for example with Python, Bash, PowerShell or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of security topics, segregation of duties, auditability and change management in regulated environments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Experience with one or more enterprise scheduling or orchestration platforms, such as SAP Central Process Scheduling, Redwood, Control\-M, Automic or equivalent products.
* Experience with SAP on HANA, S/4HANA, Central Finance, RISE with SAP, SAP BTP or SAP\-related integration technologies.
* Experience operating in hybrid or cloud environments and integrating scheduling with APIs, event\-driven services, data pipelines or cloud\-native workloads.
* Experience with process\-level monitoring, business process observability or proactive operations.
* Experience in FinTech, banking, travel, retail or another regulated, high\-volume enterprise environment.
* Experience contributing to technology product selection, proof\-of\-concept work or platform implementation.
* Familiarity with SOx, DORA, NIST or comparable regulatory and control frameworks.

**Where You’ll Be**
-------------------


This role offers a flexible hybrid model.

title: Senior FI Specialist
description:
Role Description:

Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is a global powerhouse in online travel, connecting millions of people with unforgettable experiences in over 220 countries and territories. With a market value of approximately $120 billion and a diverse portfolio of brands such as Booking.com, KAYAK, Priceline, Agoda.com and OpenTable, we’re committed to making it easier to explore everyone to experience the world.


Booking Holdings Bangalore is a cutting\-edge Center of Excellence in Bangalore, India and a key arm of Booking Holdings Inc. Top talent from diverse backgrounds converge here to develop innovative solutions that drive Booking Holdings' brands and business units forward. We offer a vibrant and inclusive workplace that fosters creativity, growth and opportunities to make a real difference on a global scale.

  

From bustling cities to remote corners, Booking Holdings' travel brands span 220\+ countries. Our FinTech team powers the financial engine behind this global network. We craft bespoke payment solutions, blending security with scalability. These tools empower our partners, fueling their growth and enhancing traveler experiences. By supporting our partners' success, we strengthen the foundation of our diverse travel ecosystem.

  

We are seeking a seasoned **Senior FI Specialist** **(IC Role)** with 15\+ years of hands\-on experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance (FICO) and enterprise architecture. Operating as a lead technical authority and individual contributor, you will drive the architectural blueprint, end\-to\-end solution design, and technical delivery of enterprise\-scale Record\-to\-Report (R2R) platforms.


This role requires deep functional and technical expertise in SAP S/4HANA, high\-volume transactional integrations (specifically with BRIM), and modern enterprise financial platforms. You will serve as the primary bridge between Finance leadership, Product Managers, Technical Architects, and System Integrators (SIs), shaping the future of our financial tech stack, safeguarding North Star Architecture (NSA) principles, and ensuring zero\-defect accounting compliance across complex ERP transformation programs (including RISE with SAP).

**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

#### **1\. Architectural Leadership \& Engineering Excellence**

* **Solution Architecture Ownership:** Own the end\-to\-end architecture and solution design for SAP S/4HANA Finance (R2R) across all project phases (Explore, Realize, Deploy, Hypercare), ensuring strict alignment between core accounting principles, business requirements, and system scalability.
* **Core FICO Domain Expertise:** Drive design authority across core domains:


	+ General Ledger (GL): Universal Journal (ACDOCA), parallel ledgers, document splitting, multi\-currency frameworks, and financial close automation.
	+ Asset Accounting (AA): Asset lifecycle management, multi\-GAAP depreciation areas, and integration workflows.
	+ Subledger Accounting (AP/AR \& FICA): Business Partner and Contract Account master data, posting areas, main/sub configurations, payment processing, and open\-item clearing.
	+ Intercompany Accounting: Cross\-entity netting, intercompany settlement routing, and period\-end elimination matching.
	+ Managerial Accounting (CO): Cost/Profit Center accounting, internal orders, margin analysis, and managerial reporting.
* **ABAP \& Technical Oversight:** Conduct deep\-code reviews, debugging, and root\-cause analysis. Guide engineering teams on SAP programming best practices, performance tuning, and database optimization (ACDOCA/HANA views).
* **WRICEF Governance \& Clean Core:** Review and validate WRICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms) objects. Drive strict "Clean Core" standardization vs. customization decisions to minimize technical debt and avoid unnecessary custom builds.
* **Design Governance \& Quality Control:** Review and sign off on Solution Design Documents (SDDs), Enterprise Structure Key Design Decisions (KDDs), and L3–L5 process maps. Ensure all designs meet strict audit readiness, SOX controls, and financial compliance standards.

#### **2\. Enterprise Integrations \& Ecosystem Orchestration**

* **BRIM Integration:** Drive deep integration designs between FI and SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) to ensure compliant order\-to\-cash, billing ingestion, and revenue accounting (IFRS 15\) flows.
* **Ecosystem Connectivity:** Architect robust integration patterns connecting SAP with third\-party and ecosystem platforms, including BlackLine (Intercompany Hub, SOX Certifications, Multi\-Source Reconciliations), OneStream/FinDB, Snowflake data lakes, and custom middleware (MuleSoft API gateways).
* **Reconciliation Integrity:** Validate end\-to\-end data pipelines (Subledger \-\>GL \-\> Reporting platforms), ensuring complete financial reconciliation, zero data loss, and zero breaks in double\-entry accounting logic.

#### **3\. SAP Transformation \& RISE Implementation**

* **RISE Execution:** Serve as the lead technical authority on large\-scale programs such as RISE with SAP / S/4HANA transformation programs across Explore, Realize, Deploy, and Hypercare phases.
* **System Integrator (SI) Challenge:** Partner closely with System Integrators to validate, guide, and challenge proposed solutions, stopping rigid template\-driven approaches that do not fit the enterprise's long\-term architectural vision.
* **Migration \& Cutover:** Oversee financial data migration strategies, cutover plans, parallel\-run validations, and testing frameworks (SIT/UAT) from a technical finance standpoint.

#### **4\. Strategic Influence \& Stakeholder Management**

* **Cross\-Track Alignment:** Act as an individual contributor thought\-leader and bridge between Finance, Engineering, Product Management, and external partners, translating complex business requirements into elegant system behaviors.
* **Domain Mentorship:** Foster internal engineering/architectural capability by mentoring junior/mid\-level engineers and architects on SAP S/4HANA best practices, integration patterns, and emerging technologies (e.g., AI/automation in month\-end financial closing).

#### **5\. Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**

* **Financial Process Automation \& AI:** Evaluate, architect, and prototype emerging automation technologies, including AI/ML use cases for intelligent anomaly detection, Business Process Automation, Document AI, automated cash application, AI\-assisted month\-end close (MEC) forecasting, and robotic process automation (RPA), to reduce manual finance effort and improve reporting accuracy.
* **Architecture Evolution \& "Clean Core"**: Continually assess technical debt across our SAP and connected ecosystems. Proactively design refactoring plans to decouple legacy custom code, migrating toward SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) services, standard APIs, and "Clean Core" extensibility patterns.
* **Benchmarking \& Tooling Optimization:** Research industry best practices and stay ahead of the curve on vendor roadmaps (SAP S/4HANA releases, RISE updates, BlackLine innovations, BRIM enhancements). Identify opportunities to replace expensive custom builds with native out\-of\-the\-box system capabilities.
* **Engineering Thought Leadership:** Act as a catalyst for continuous improvement within the engineering track by introducing automated testing frameworks for SAP, CI/CD pipeline enhancements for transport manager

**What You’ll Be Bringing**
---------------------------

* **Experience:** 15\+ years of progressive experience in SAP Finance (FI/CO), with at least 7\+ years in solution architecture, lead engineering, or technical authority roles.
* **Role Focus:** Proven track record as a high\-impact Individual Contributor capable of driving architectural consensus without direct line management authority.
* **S/4HANA Expertise:** Successfully delivered 2 to 4 end\-to\-end S/4HANA greenfield/brownfield implementations or global rollouts, including international localization and multi\-gap tax/regulatory requirements.
* **Integration Track Record:** Hands\-on experience architecting FI integrations with SAP BRIM (Billing, Convergent Invoicing, FICA) and external subledgers/billing platforms.
* **Transformation Experience:** Direct architectural leadership in at least one full lifecycle RISE with SAP or S/4HANA Cloud deployment.
* **Technical Depth:** Expert\-level capability in analyzing custom ABAP code, debugging standard/custom SAP flows, designing complex APIs/interfaces, and structuring custom data models.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep familiarity with financial closing and reconciliation platforms such as BlackLine (ICH, Matching, Close Management) or OneStream.
* Strong understanding of modern reporting layers (SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP BTP, BI/BW, Snowflake).
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum product management methodologies in enterprise software tracks.
* Exposure to financial process automation, machine learning in cash application, or AI\-driven anomaly detection in financial close operations.

**Where You’ll Be**
-------------------


This role offers a flexible hybrid model.

title: RF Planning & Optimization Engineer
description:
Job Description
**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry\-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026\.

 **About Position:**

  

We are seeking an experienced RF Planning \& Optimization Engineer to support the design, analysis, and optimization of 4G LTE and 5G NR networks. The role involves RF planning activities such as coverage and capacity analysis, propagation modeling, link\-budget calculations, frequency planning, and interference troubleshooting using industry\-standard tools like ATOLL, Planet, and iBwave. The ideal candidate will work closely with product development, QA, and customer teams to analyze network scenarios, validate solutions, and drive performance improvements. Strong knowledge of wireless technologies, Massive MIMO, SON concepts, and radio network optimization is essential for success in this role.

* **Role: RF Planning \& Optimization Engineer**
* **Location: Pune, Bengaluru**
* **Experience: 8 to 12 Years**
* **Job Type: Full\-Time Employment**

 **What You'll Do:**

  

* Perform RF planning, design, and optimization activities for 4G LTE and 5G NR networks to achieve targeted coverage, capacity, and quality objectives.
* Analyze and troubleshoot RF network performance issues, including coverage gaps, interference, mobility, and capacity constraints.
* Conduct link budget analysis, RF propagation modeling, coverage prediction, and capacity planning using industry\-standard planning tools.
* Develop and optimize PCI plans, frequency plans, carrier allocation, and neighbor relations to improve network performance and user experience.
* Support coverage and capacity scenario planning, traffic analysis, and Monte Carlo simulations for network expansion and optimization projects.
* Investigate customer\-reported issues, reproduce network scenarios, and validate software fixes within RF planning and optimization environments.
* Perform interference analysis and troubleshooting for LTE and 5G networks, ensuring optimal spectrum utilization.
* Execute handover parameter optimization, ANR validation, and mobility optimization activities to enhance network reliability and accessibility.
* Collaborate with Product Development, QA, Customer Support, and cross\-functional teams to resolve complex technical issues and improve planning workflows.
* Analyze and maintain site databases, frequency planning data, geographic information, and terrain datasets to ensure planning accuracy.
* Support SON\-based optimization initiatives, including Mobility Robustness Optimization (MRO), Mobility Load Balancing (MLB), and Radio Link Failure (RLF) optimization.
* Work with RF planning tools such as ATOLL, Planet, iBwave, or equivalent solutions to validate network designs and generate performance recommendations.
* Prepare technical reports, network performance analyses, and optimization recommendations for internal and customer stakeholders.
* Stay updated on emerging wireless technologies, including 5G NR, Massive MIMO, Beamforming, and cloud\-based telecom planning solutions

 **Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* Strong experience in RF Planning \& Optimization for 4G LTE and 5G NR networks, with a solid understanding of radio network design principles and optimization techniques.
* Hands\-on expertise in RF propagation modeling, coverage prediction, link\-budget analysis, and capacity planning.
* Knowledge of PCI planning, frequency planning, interference analysis, carrier planning, and mobility optimization for LTE and 5G networks.
* Understanding of Massive MIMO, Beamforming, coverage versus capacity optimization, and 5G NR planning parameters and KPIs.
* Experience with Automatic Frequency Planning (AFP), Neighbor Cell Planning, ANR, Handover Optimization, and SON\-based optimization workflows (MRO, MLB, RLF).
* Proficiency in RF planning and optimization tools such as ATOLL, Planet, iBwave, or equivalent wireless network planning solutions.
* Ability to analyze customer\-reported issues, reproduce network scenarios, validate software fixes, and provide effective technical resolutions.
* Experience managing site databases, frequency planning data, geographic information, and terrain datasets for accurate network planning.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret network performance metrics and KPIs.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience collaborating across product, QA, customer support, and global engineering teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Exposure to 2G/3G planning concepts, telecom performance analytics, cloud\-based telecom planning platforms, and network automation frameworks is a plus.

 **Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

 **Values\-Driven, People\-Centric \& Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility\-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

description:
Closing date for applications: 29/09/2026



Location Bangalore, India


Job typePermanent \| Contract typeFull Time


\#R\-00284335

  



**Join our digital revolution in NatWest Digital X**
----------------------------------------------------


In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.


So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.


**Job description**
-------------------


This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.


Join us as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineering


* You’ll be the voice of our customers, using data to tell their stories and put them at the heart of all decision\-making
* We’ll look to you to drive the build of effortless, digital first customer experiences
* If you’re ready for a new challenge and want to make a far\-reaching impact through your work, this could be the opportunity you’re looking for
* We're offering this role at vice president level

**What you'll do**
------------------


As a Data Engineer, You'll need extensive experience in analytics engineering, data modelling and data strategy, with deep expertise in canonical modelling, semantic modelling, governed data products, Snowflake and modern analytics engineering practices. As a Principal Analytics Engineering Lead for PBWM, you'll provide strategic and technical leadership across the data and analytics landscape, defining standards, governance frameworks and best practices while shaping the analytical data strategy. You'll work closely with business stakeholders, architects, engineers, analysts and governance teams to design scalable, trusted and reusable data solutions that align with enterprise architecture and business objectives. You'll also enable self\-service analytics, reporting, AI and advanced data products through robust canonical and semantic models that drive consistency, quality and business value across the organisation.


You'll act as a senior member of the Analytics Engineering team, bringing deep expertise in analytical data architecture, canonical and semantic data modelling, data product governance, and Analytics Engineering. You'll provide technical leadership across PBWM, partnering with senior business and technology stakeholders to align data capabilities with strategic objectives, drive enterprise data standards, and influence architecture and governance decisions. You'll lead the design and governance of complex cross\-domain data models and trusted data products, establish DataOps and analytics engineering best practices including dbt, CI/CD, testing, lineage, and data quality frameworks, and champion reusable, product\-based data delivery. You'll also mentor analytics engineers and data modellers, foster engineering excellence and innovation, and represent PBWM in enterprise architecture, governance, and data strategy forums while ensuring compliance with regulatory, privacy, and governance requirements.


Your responsibilities will also include:


* Building advanced automation of data engineering pipelines through removal of manual stages
* Embedding new data techniques into our business through role modelling, training, and experiment design oversight
* Delivering a clear understanding of data platform costs to meet your departments cost saving and income targets
* Sourcing new data using the most appropriate tooling for the situation
* Developing solutions for streaming data ingestion and transformations in line with our streaming strategy

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------


To thrive in this role, you’ll need a strong understanding of data usage and dependencies and experience of extracting value and features from large scale data. You'll need at least fifteen years of experience in Analytics Engineering, Data Architecture, Data Modelling, Data Platform Engineering, or related disciplines, with deep expertise in canonical and semantic data modelling, data product design, metadata management, lineage, governance frameworks, and product\-oriented architectures. You'll bring expert SQL skills and advanced hands\-on experience with dbt, including models, macros, testing frameworks, documentation, lineage, CI/CD integration, and enterprise\-scale project delivery.


You'll need extensive experience with Snowflake, covering architecture, performance tuning, cost optimisation, data governance, security, Cortex, and emerging platform capabilities, alongside a strong understanding of cloud\-native analytical platforms on AWS, including S3, Glue, Athena, Iceberg, IAM, security controls, and governance, with SageMaker Unified Studio preferred. Experience within Financial Services, ideally Personal Banking \& Wealth Management (PBWM), will be advantageous, along with knowledge of PBWM products and customer journeys, DAMA/DMBOK or similar governance frameworks, and UK regulatory requirements covering GDPR, data privacy, retention obligations, conduct, suitability, regulatory reporting, and audit controls.


Additionally, you’ll need:


* Experience of ETL technical design, data quality testing, cleansing and monitoring, data sourcing, and exploration and analysis
* Data warehousing and data modelling capabilities
* A good understanding of modern code development practices
* Experience of working in a governed, and regulatory environment
* Strong communication skills with the ability to proactively engage and manage a wide range of stakeholders

**Welcome to our Bangalore hub**
--------------------------------


Located at Taurus 4, Bagmane Constellation Business Park, our new office stands as a state\-of\-the\-art hub for innovation and collaboration.


### **Key facts:**


* A 30 acre campus
* Space for 6,000 colleagues
* Opened in 2025

**What Makes You Stand Out**

* Ability to work effectively within cross\-functional and Agile teams.

* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical information for non\-technical partners.
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and documentation.
* Ability to influence and collaborate across teams and geographies.
* Demonstrated ownership, adaptability, and willingness to embrace new technologies.
* Ability to understand and work across multiple technology stacks.
**Your Background**
-------------------


* 4 \+ years of experience designing and developing SQL\-based pipelines and data models.
* **Power BI (Desktop/Service) and DAX (measures, KPI logic, performance basics)**
* SQL (strong expertise), Snowflake, and data modeling
* Hands\-on experience delivering or supporting **Power BI** datasets/semantic models and implementing DAX measures for enterprise KPIs.

* Experience with Snowflake or other cloud data warehouses.
* Experience with orchestration platforms such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect.
* Experience with ingestion tools (Fivetran, Nifi, Airbyte) is a plus.
* Familiarity with APIs, JSON/CSV/XML/Parquet data formats, and cloud storage environments.
* Understanding of CDC mechanisms, data governance, and security best practices.
* Exposure to real\-time or streaming ingestion (Kafka, EventHub) is beneficial.
* Experience working in Agile environments and delivering iterative outcomes.
* Ability to participate in and lead technical discussions.
* Interest or exposure to AI/ML workflows is a plus.

**Preferred:**

* Python for data pipelines and automation
* dbt / SQL\-based transformation frameworks
* Airflow, Dagster, or similar orchestration tools
* CI/CD tools (GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps)
* ETL/ELT tools such as Fivetran, Airbyte, Apache Nifi (preferred)
* Cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud storage
* Git\-based version control.

-----------------------



Up to 5%

Work closely with cross\-functional partners in Ads Safety, AP Engineering, and gTech, architect defense\-in\-depth strategies that balance user safety with a streamlined advertiser experience. --------------------

* Direct and mentor a high\-performing team of Engineering Analysts, fostering AI transformation, operational excellence and strategic execution against adversarial fraud.
* Partner with PM, Engineering, and Legal to build Defense in Depth strategies that enhance user safety and fortify the Google Ads ecosystem against emerging threats.
* Lead the development of AI\-driven enforcement capabilities, to proactively combat abuse at scale. Establish robust evaluation frameworks for the AI era, pioneering rigorous measurement methodologies and overseeing programs to train next\-generation AI agents/ML Models for fraud detection.
* Lead investigations into complex TTPs (Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures) to perform actor tracking and disrupt organized fraud rings targeting Google Ads.

**Project Role Description :** Support the operations and/or manage delivery for production systems and services based on operational requirements and service agreement.
  

**Must have skills :** Batch Scheduling Tools \& Techniques  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **3** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As an Operations Engineer, you will support the operations and manage delivery for production systems and services based on operational requirements and service agreements. Your typical day will involve collaborating with various teams to ensure seamless operations, troubleshooting issues, and implementing solutions to enhance system performance. You will engage in monitoring system health, analyzing performance metrics, and ensuring compliance with service level agreements, all while fostering a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and efficiency.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Own administration, configuration, and ongoing support of Stonebranch Universal Automation Center (UAC) in a 24x7 production environment.
* Design, implement, and optimize complex workflows, tasks, triggers, calendars, and variables to meet SLA and throughput requirements.
* Manage enterprise\-scale batch workloads, including dynamic and dependent workflows.
* Lead onboarding, enhancement, and decommissioning of batch jobs in coordination with application and release management teams.
* Monitor execution, analyze failures and performance trends, and drive root cause analysis and permanent fixes.
* Configure alerts, notifications, and integrations with monitoring, ticketing, and reporting systems.
* Produce operational and SLA reports using UAC logs, task instance data, and historical execution metrics.
* Support audit and compliance activities (SOX/PCI), including documentation of scheduling activity, execution history, and change records.
* Participate in DR planning and testing, ensuring workflow recoverability and scheduling resiliency.
* Act as a senior escalation point for Priority 1 incidents and major incident calls.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to onshore/offshore operations teams.
* Maintain standards, runbooks, and automation best practices aligned with ITIL processes.


  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* 3\-4 years of experience in enterprise workload automation, with strong hands\-on expertise in Stonebranch UAC.
* Proven experience designing and supporting large, complex batch workflows in production environments.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across application, infrastructure, and automation layers.
* Experience with workload automation tools such as Control\-M, IBM Workload Automation, ActiveBatch, RunMyJobs, will be additional etc.
* Exposure to BMC Helix integration is highly desirable.
* Experience in 24x7 operations, on\-call rotations, and major incident management.
* Strong documentation, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Relevant technical or ITIL certifications preferred.


  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Stonebranch Universal Automation Center (UAC)
* This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

  

15 years full time education

Transforming the insurance industry is ambitious, we know. We’re searching for a **Staff Engineer** to join our **Engineering team** in Bengaluru location. This is a senior technical leadership role built around quality\-led, AI\-first product and quality engineering. You will define and drive the application architecture for our platform — designing scalable, resilient systems in .NET and Angular/React — while embedding quality engineering into every architectural decision. You'll champion AI\-powered development practices across the entire SDLC, set the technical vision for quality at the architecture level, and mentor engineering teams on building software that is correct by construction, not just tested after the fact. We're looking for someone who sees quality not as a phase but as an architectural property, who leads through technical excellence, and who thrives at the intersection of product engineering, quality engineering, and AI\-driven innovation. **Required Skills:*** Education: BE, B. Tech, M. Tech Only
* Experience Level: 12\-15\+ Years of hands\-on software engineering experience, with 4\+ years in Leading or principal/staff engineer role

**Mandatory Skills (Full\-Stack \+ Quality \& Product Engineering)*** Deep expertise in .NET framework (C\#, ASP.NET, .NET Core) and modern frontend frameworks (Angular 10\+ and/or ReactJS with TypeScript).
* Proven experience designing and owning application architectures: service decomposition, API design, data modelling, and system integration patterns.
* Strong proficiency in microservice architecture, event\-driven programming, async design patterns, and distributed systems.
* Extensive experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and Web APIs with a focus on contract\-first design.
* Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript for building robust, accessible user interfaces.
* Solid experience with relational databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL) including schema design, query optimisation, and performance tuning.
* Expert\-level quality engineering mindset: deep experience with test automation frameworks, unit/integration/end\-to\-end testing, contract testing, and performance/load testing at the architecture level.
* Proven ability to embed quality gates in CI/CD pipelines — linting, static analysis, test coverage thresholds, security scanning, and automated regression.
* Strong understanding of quality management principles: defect prevention strategies, root cause analysis, test planning, quality metrics, and continuous quality improvement across the product lifecycle.
* Demonstrated expertise using AI\-powered development tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, AI code\-review/test\-generation tools) and defining AI SDLC standards for engineering teams.
* Experience with version control systems (Git), branching strategies, and code review practices at scale.
* Strong architecture documentation skills — ADRs, system design documents, sequence diagrams, and quality engineering playbooks.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to articulate technical decisions to both engineering and business audiences.
* Proven ability to mentor and lead engineers across multiple teams; strong track record of raising the technical and quality bar.

**What You’ll Do*** Own and evolve the application architecture for full\-stack systems built on .NET (C\#, ASP.NET Core) and Angular/React, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and quality by design.
* Design quality\-first architectures: embed testability, observability, fault isolation, and graceful degradation as first\-class architectural concerns — not afterthoughts.
* Define and drive the AI\-first engineering strategy: establish standards for AI\-powered development tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot, AI code\-review/test\-generation tools) and AI SDLC best practices across engineering teams.
* Design and build microservice\-based, event\-driven systems with async design patterns, ensuring resilience, loose coupling, and horizontal scalability.
* Lead the quality engineering practice at the architecture level: define test automation strategies, contract testing frameworks, performance/load testing architectures, and shift\-left quality gates embedded in CI/CD pipelines.
* Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and architectural decision records (ADRs) that raise the quality bar across all product engineering teams.
* Collaborate with product managers, engineering leads, QA leadership, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions and architectural roadmaps.
* Drive cross\-team technical alignment: review system designs, conduct architecture reviews, and ensure consistency across services and modules.
* Mentor and coach senior and mid\-level engineers on architecture principles, quality engineering practices, AI tool adoption, and full\-stack development excellence.
* Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies, AI/ML frameworks, and quality tools to continuously improve engineering velocity, reliability, and product quality.
* Prepare and maintain architectural documentation including system design documents, ADRs, runbooks, and quality engineering playbooks.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement — run blameless postmortems, quality retrospectives, and proactively identify architectural debt and quality risks.

 **You may have other skills, including**  

Experience with the following technologies a plus* Experience with AWS cloud services (EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, ECS/EKS, CloudWatch) or equivalent cloud platforms (Azure, GCP).
* Experience with containerisation and orchestration tools — Docker \& Kubernetes — and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD, TeamCity, Octopus Deploy, or similar build/release tooling.
* Experience with API management platforms such as Apigee and local development workflow tools like Tilt.
* Experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog, Splunk, or similar — including defining SLIs, SLOs, and alerting strategies.
* Knowledge of AI/ML frameworks or platforms and their application in software engineering and quality engineering workflows.
* Experience with cloud\-native architectural patterns: serverless, service mesh, CQRS, event sourcing.
* Familiarity with security architecture principles — OWASP, secure coding practices, and DevSecOps integration.

 **When You Join Team Applied, You Can Expect:** **A culture that values who you are** and recognizes that you aren’t just an employee; you are a teammate, and you matter. We thrive on the benefits of our different experiences and celebrate the uniqueness our teammates bring to work with them every day.**We flex our time together**, collaborating remotely and in\-person to empower our teams to work in the ways that work best for them. **Learn more about the people behind our products at** –* LinkedIn Page Applied Systems India
