description:
**Senior Associate Technology Risk Prompt Engineer**
====================================================

Req ID: 124055
Department: Chief Information Risk Office
Division: Risk
Location: Bengaluru
**About Us**
------------

  

**Standard**  

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

  


As a Senior Associate, Technology Risk Prompt Engineering in our Risk, Group Technology team, you will operate as a hands\-on partner to Senior Managers, Risk Managers, and fellow Associates to deliver decision\-useful monitoring and automation across material Technology and Information Security (Cyber) risk themes.


You’ll combine hands\-on data analysis and evidence collation with governed automation and AI\-assisted drafting to improve timeliness, consistency and quality of insights.  

  

You’ll build, test and maintain prompt and retrieval patterns, co\-pilot agents and workflow automations using approved tooling (where authorised), while learning and



Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  


**Role Type: Permanent**  

**Role Location: Bengaluru**  

**Work Hours: 7 AM to 4 PM**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

  

As a Senior Associate, Technology Risk Prompt Engineering, you will:

  


* Supporting delivery of the insights plan by translating priority insight routines into a practical delivery backlog of automation and  

agent use\-cases (as agreed with the Senior Manager, Technology Risk Insights)
* Working with Risk Officers and SMEs to capture repeatable workflows (report refreshes, evidence collation, control attestations,issues tracking) and translating them into clear automation/agent requirements with agreed acceptance criteria
* Building and maintaining insight assets (datasets, definitions, lineage notes, dashboards and briefing packs) that provide timely,trusted insight on control effectiveness, resilience outcomes, risk\-in\-change and remediation progress
* Building and maintaining workflow automations (data extraction, transformation, scheduling, approvals and notifications) to improve timeliness, reduce manual effort and increase consistency of risk reporting and insight delivery
* Supporting integration with existing platforms (reporting datasets, SharePoint/Teams and risk tooling) and contributing to userguidance and adoption (how\-to guides, training snippets, support triage and continuous improvement)
* Coordinating with Technology, Cyber, Risk, Data and Internal Audit stakeholders on analytics, automation and agent use\-cases,definitions, thresholds and evidence expectations to improve consistency and reduce duplication
* Continuously improving templates, automations and agent behaviours to increase consistency, timeliness and decisionusefulness;documenting lessons learned and maintaining a clear change log of updates
* Supporting uplift tracking (e.g., PACT\-aligned measures) by automating evidence collation and improving repeatability of reporting outputs
* Operating as a hands\-on specialist, demonstrating strong documentation and quality discipline so automations and agents are safe, repeatable and supportable
**What will you bring?**
------------------------

  

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  


* Experience in automation, engineering delivery, analytics engineering, risk analytics or a similar role, with evidence of delivering workflow solutions used by business teams
* Hands\-on experience with prompt engineering and building AI\-assisted workflows/agents using approved tooling (e.g., Microsoft Copilot ecosystem) including evaluation, guardrails and iteration based on user feedback
* Strong data skills: ability to work with structured and semi\-structured data, define data quality checks and build reliable refresh pipelines for recurring reporting (e.g., SQL and data wrangling)
* Experience with workflow automation and integration tooling (e.g., Power Automate), scripting (Python preferred) and/or APIs, plus strong documentation and runbook discipline
* Experience delivering solutions for Technology Risk, Cyber Risk, Operational Risk or governance/reporting teams within Financial Services
* Working understanding of risk and control concepts (e.g., technology/cyber risk, operational risk, issues/incidents, control testing) and the ability to translate policy/standards into practical checks within an agent or workflow
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills: ability to capture pain points, prototype solutions and deliver fit\-for\-purpose outcomes; comfortable taking guidance and escalating risks and blockers early
* Tertiary qualifications in a relevant discipline (Computer Science, Data/Analytics, Engineering, Information Systems), or equivalent practical experience.

  

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.

**So why join us?**
-------------------

  




ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.

  



We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.

  



We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.

  



To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/. You can

title: Applications Engineering, Sr Engineer (FPGA, RTL Design & Emulation)
description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India


**Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18858 **Date posted** 09/16/2026
### **We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You have spent the last few years deep in FPGA design and implementation, and you have learned that the real work begins when a customer's design does not compile the way they expected or when partitioning across multiple FPGAs creates timing issues no one saw coming. You are the engineer who stays on the call until the problem is solved, not because you have to, but because leaving something half\-fixed bothers you.


You are comfortable reading Verilog or SystemVerilog that someone else wrote, understanding what they were trying to do, and figuring out why the synthesis tool is choking on it. You know your way around FPGA architecture well enough to explain why a design that worked fine in simulation is failing in hardware, and you can do it in a way that does not make the customer feel like they missed something obvious.


Working with customers energizes you. You like the variety of problems, the pressure of real deadlines, and the satisfaction of helping someone get unstuck. You do not need everything documented perfectly to move forward. You ask the right questions, dig into log files, reproduce issues locally, and escalate to R\&D when needed with enough context that they can actually help.


At Synopsys, you will work with some of the most complex emulation and prototyping workflows in the industry, supporting global customers who depend on Zebu and Protocompiler to verify chips that power everything from automotive systems to data centers.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Provide technical support to global customers using Synopsys Zebu Emulation and Protocompiler Prototyping software, troubleshooting issues across partitioning, synthesis, place and route, and hardware debug
* Work directly with customers to migrate their designs to new software releases, ensuring compatibility and resolving any regressions or performance issues that surface
* Deploy new software features on live customer designs, helping them adopt capabilities like advanced partitioning algorithms, new debug modes, or updated FPGA target support
* Deliver technical training sessions to customers, ranging from basic tool usage to advanced workflows for multi\-FPGA partitioning and hardware\-software co\-verification
* Collaborate with Synopsys HAV R\&D teams to report customer issues, provide reproducible test cases, and advocate for product improvements based on real\-world usage patterns
* Support pre\-sales evaluations by running customer designs through the Synopsys emulation and prototyping flow, demonstrating performance and identifying potential adoption blockers
* Travel occasionally to customer sites for onsite support, training, or critical issue resolution

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable customers to bring up complex SoC designs on emulation and prototyping platforms faster, reducing their verification cycle time by weeks or months
* Improve product quality by surfacing real customer pain points to R\&D with enough technical detail that fixes can be prioritized and implemented effectively
* Build customer confidence in Synopsys HAV solutions through responsive, expert\-level support that helps them solve problems they could not solve on their own
* Expand adoption of new software features by showing customers how to use them on their actual designs, not just in demos
* Reduce escalations and support load over time by delivering training that helps customers become more self\-sufficient with the toolchain
* Strengthen customer relationships by being the engineer they trust to pick up the phone when something is broken and production timelines are at risk
* Contribute to the technical knowledge base and internal best practices that make the entire support organization more effective

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelors in Electronics Engineering with 2\-3 years of experience, or Master's in Electronics Engineering with 1\-2 years, specifically in emulation or prototyping environments
* Hands\-on experience with logic design and implementation using FPGAs, including synthesis, place and route, and timing closure
* Strong working knowledge of Verilog, System Verilog, or VHDL, including the ability to read, debug, and modify RTL written by others
* Practical experience with FPGA architecture and back\-end implementation flows, including understanding of resource utilization, clock domain crossing, and design partitioning
* Exposure to Xilinx or Altera synthesis tools is a plus, as is familiarity with Synopsys Prototyping or Emulation hardware and software
* Experience with interface protocols like PCIe, AXI, UART, or I2C is a plus, particularly in the context of hardware\-software integration
* Scripting experience in Python, Tcl, or shell is desirable for automating workflows and analyzing log files

### **Who You Are**

* You can take a vague customer complaint like "the compile is failing" and turn it into a specific, reproducible issue with enough detail that R\&D can act on it
* You stay calm when a customer is frustrated or under pressure, and you focus on solving the problem rather than defending the tool
* You are comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple customer issues in parallel without losing track of who needs what by when
* You do not mind digging through synthesis logs, waveform dumps, or FPGA utilization reports to find the root cause of a problem
* You can explain a complex technical tradeoff, like why a design needs to be repartitioned or why certain optimizations are not possible, in a way that makes sense to someone who is not an FPGA expert
* You are open to occasional travel for customer support, training, or onsite troubleshooting when remote support is not enough

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


You will join Synopsys Technical Sales Group (TSG) as part of the Hardware Assisted Verification (HAV) team, working alongside expert\-level field engineers who support customers globally on Zebu Emulation and Protocompiler Prototyping solutions. The team works closely with R\&D and directly with customers at all stages of the emulation and prototyping cycle, from pre\-sales evaluation through post\-deployment support. You will collaborate with engineers across geographies and gain exposure to Synopsys HAV hardware platforms as part of your technical development.


At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

You will work with the wider global network and IT teams, business partners and managed service vendors to design, engineer and operate the physical and logical Enterprise Security infrastructure (Zscaler Secure Service Edge, firewalls, remote access platforms, cloud proxies, microsegmentation (Zscaler and Guardicore), cloud security \& perimeter security devices etc.) portfolio in Johnson Controls. Our Network infrastructure consists of a large global footprint of more than one thousand sites supporting over one hundred thousand employees ranging from datacenters, manufacturing plants, sales branches, and customer contact centers with exposure to a wide range of exciting network technologies and vendors such as Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA, DLP, AI Security and Microsegmentation), Fortinet, Zscaler ZT Branch Connector, Akamai Guardicore, Imperva WAF, Forescout, Microsoft Azure, Amazon AWS and many more partners.

  

The role will be working as part of a global high\-performance team focused on continuous network security infrastructure delivery and upgrades, maintenance and operational activities, delivery of security configurations and services, incident and change management, network security design and compliance, equipment ordering, scheduling, security device life cycle management, operational handover, vendor management and network security infrastructure asset management.

**Required**

* Experience working with 3rd party vendors and managed network service providers.
* Great organisational skills.
* Strong experience of working on SIEM tools to analyze logs and correlate events.
* Solid understanding of industry standard Cybersecurity Frameworks and compliance requirements
* Experience in Enterprise level network security incidents and change Management process.

**About Carrier**

  

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting\-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life\-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world\-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the centre of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

* **About the role****:**

Designs, builds, and evolves enterprise data and AI capabilities that enable reliable, secure, and scalable digital solutions across the organization. Oversees data platforms, pipelines, analytics, and intelligent technologies to ensure high\-quality, accessible, and well\-governed data that supports operational and strategic decision\-making. Applies advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and automation to improve efficiency, accuracy, and business performance while enabling scalable and data\-driven ways of working. Establishes and enforces governance frameworks, standards, and responsible AI practices to maintain data integrity, compliance, consistency, and trusted use of enterprise technologies. Partners closely with business and technology teams to translate evolving business needs into robust data and AI solutions that drive innovation, operational maturity, and long\-term enterprise value. **JOB RESPONSIBILITY:**


1\. Platform Architecture \& Technical Ownership

* Own the overall architecture of the enterprise data platform based on a Lakehouse paradigm, covering storage, compute, metadata, governance, and observability.
* Define and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, and architectural standards applicable across AWS and GCP.
* Act as the final technical authority for platform‑level architectural decisions, trade‑offs, and exceptions.
* Ensure architectural choices support scalability, resilience, security, cost efficiency, and operational excellence.


2\. Lakehouse \& Open‑Standards Strategy

* Design the platform around open data standards to ensure portability and long‑term flexibility.
* Standardize on open table formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg or equivalent) and open file formats (e.g., Parquet) as the foundation of the Lakehouse.
* Enforce separation of storage and compute, enabling multiple analytics and processing engines without vendor lock‑in.
* Define principles for schema evolution, ACID guarantees, time travel, and multi‑engine interoperability.


3\. Multi‑Cloud Platform Design (AWS \& GCP)

* Architect the Lakehouse platform to run on AWS and GCP, with cloud‑specific implementations mapped to a common logical architecture.
* Define standards and patterns for:
* Cloud‑native storage and processing services
* Environment isolation (dev / test / prod)
* Networking and identity models
* Security, encryption, and access controls
* Establish cloud‑agnostic abstractions and guardrails so data products behave consistently across clouds.
* Ensure platform design aligns with enterprise security, compliance, and cost‑management requirements.

API Architecture: Proven track record of designing, building, and consuming scalable REST or gRPC APIs.

**Job Role** :


Seeking a Full Stack / Backend Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable cloud services and modern web/client interfaces. In this role, you will develop robust backend APIs, integrate distributed cloud databases, and build lightweight client\-side components and browser\-based tools.


You will work across the software development lifecycle, Go services and TypeScript client logic to querying enterprise SQL databases (including distributed relational systems like Cloud Spanner) and deploying containerized microservices to modern serverless environments (Cloud Run).


**Responsibilities** :  

  



Backend \& API Development: Design, implement, and maintain secure, high\-throughput RESTful and/or gRPC APIs using Go (Golang) and/or Python.


Frontend \& Client Integration: Develop and maintain client\-side modules using TypeScript / JavaScript; build or enhance browser\-based tools (such as Chrome Extensions) to streamline user workflows.


Database Design \& Query Optimization: Write efficient, production\-grade SQL queries, design schemas, and handle data migrations with a focus on distributed relational databases (Cloud Spanner).


Cloud \& Serverless Deployment: Deploy, manage, and scale containerized applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) leveraging Cloud Run and container workflows via Artifact Registry.


System Reliability \& DevOps: Package services with Docker, automate routine deployment workflows with shell scripting (Bash), and maintain CI/CD pipelines.


Collaboration \& Code Quality: Participate in design reviews, maintain code documentation, and write unit and integration tests to ensure enterprise\-grade stability and security.

  

  

**Required skills** :


A. TypeScript / JavaScript \& Client\-Side Development


TypeScript \& Modern JS: Strong command of TypeScript (ES6\+) and modern JavaScript syntax, asynchronous programming (Promises, Async/Await), and modular architecture.


Browser \& Extension Development (Optional / Plus): Familiarity with Chrome Extension architecture (Manifest V3, background service workers, content scripts, extension messaging APIs, storage).


UI \& Integration: Experience integrating client\-side interfaces with backend services via fetch/Axios and managing state cleanly.


B. Backend Engineering \& API Design


Go (Golang): Solid understanding of Go fundamentals, goroutines, channels, standard library (net/http), and popular frameworks/routers (e.g., Gin, Chi, or standard Go idioms).


Python (Secondary / Plus): Working knowledge of Python for backend scripting, services, or automation (FastAPI, Flask).


API Development: Deep understanding of RESTful API design patterns, JSON data serialization, authentication protocols (OAuth2, JWT), error handling, and API rate limiting.


C. Database \& Data Layer (SQL \& Cloud Spanner)


Hands\-on SQL: Proficient in relational database design, indexing strategies, ACID transactions, data normalization, and complex joins.


Cloud Spanner: Familiarity or hands\-on experience working with distributed relational databases, particularly Google Cloud Spanner (schema design, query performance tuning, primary keys, interleaved tables).


D. Cloud Infrastructure (GCP) \& DevOps


GCP Services: Hands\-on familiarity with core Google Cloud Platform products, notably Cloud Run (serverless container orchestration) and Artifact Registry (container image management).


Containerization: Experience writing optimized Dockerfiles, building multi\-stage container images, and debugging container runtimes.


Shell Scripting: Proficient in Linux environments with Bash / Shell scripting for automation, build scripts, and environment configuration.

At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.


For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off\-the\-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we're building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.


Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We're a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.


**About the Role**

As a Quality Engineering Manager, you will own the quality strategy for a significant product domain while leading a talented team of Quality Engineers supporting multiple engineering teams. Through your partnership with other Quality Engineering (QE) leaders, you’ll help shape and evolve our quality tooling and practices and continue to build a culture where quality is a shared responsibility.


Our teams support quality efforts across multiple product domains, invest heavily in automation, and embrace AI\-assisted development. This role requires technical judgement, strong people leadership, and the ability to build trust across teams.


Success in this role is measured by the quality of the software your team helps deliver, the growth of the quality engineers you lead, and your ability to influence how quality is built into the software development lifecycle.


**What You'll Do**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers supporting multiple engineering teams and product initiatives.
* Own the quality strategy for a product domain by partnering closely with other leaders, tech leads, and product managers to improve software quality, delivery predictability, and customer outcomes.
* Provides technical and architectural leadership in test automation, frameworks, CI/CD, and testing standards.
* Partner with QE leadership to define and evolve scalable quality practices and AI\-assisted testing solutions, translate those into clear team priorities and goals, and drive consistent adoption to improve quality outcomes
* Balance competing priorities across multiple engineering teams, helping stakeholders understand tradeoffs while ensuring the highest\-value work receives appropriate quality investment.

Coach and mentor through clear, actionable feedback * \- developing technical and leadership capabilities, clarifying promotion expectations, and supporting career growth.
* Lead teams through ambiguity, changing priorities, and organizational change while maintaining focus, engagement, and delivery excellence.

Influence engineering teams to build quality earlier in the software development lifecycle through collaboration, data, and thoughtful decision\-making.  
* 

**About You**

You believe quality engineering is much more than finding defects — it's a shared engineering responsibility woven into how software gets built. You also lead by helping others do their best work, and you measure your own success by theirs.


You will be successful in this role if you:


* Build trust quickly with your team and other leaders and teams in the organization.
* Lead with curiosity, active listening, empathy, and thoughtful communication.
* Make informed decisions in an environment where priorities can change or information is incomplete.
* Balance customer needs, quality, delivery timelines, and business priorities when making tradeoffs
* Create an inclusive, collaborative environment where individuals feel empowered to learn, experiment, and continuously improve.
* Believe your success is a reflection of the success, engagement, and growth of your team.

**Experience We Think You'll Need**

* Demonstrated success managing and developing a high\-performing Quality Engineering team.
* Experience with or working knowledge of AI\-assisted software development; including AI assisted test generation, model evaluation, and skills/playbooks.
* Experience developing and scaling quality processes that drive greater efficiency and support organizational growth.
* Experience leading and working with distributed teams across multiple locations and time zones.
* Understanding of fundamental quality engineering strategies and practices.
* Demonstrated ability to influence decisions on teams without direct authority.

**Why Quickbase?**

At Quickbase, Quality Engineering is a strategic partner in how software is built and this role carries real scope: you’ll help shape and evolve our quality strategy not just execute someone else's plan.


Quality Engineering is also at an inflection point. We're actively building what AI\-assisted quality engineering looks like in practice, and this role has direct influence over how that evolves — not adopting a playbook someone else already wrote.


You'll do this alongside the rest of the QE leadership team \- sharing practices, tackling problems together, and growing together. You won't be leading in isolation.


If you want a role where your decisions shape how quality is built across a growing organization, and you want to help define what quality engineering looks like in an AI\-driven future, we'd love to talk.

  

  

**Important Notices**  

**Recorded Interviews.** Quickbase uses an interview recording tool to record and transcribe interviews for evaluation purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. By participating in an interview, you consent to this recording and transcription.
  

**Interview Integrity.** AI is part of how we work at Quickbase — we expect you to use it too. Your application and interviews should still reflect you and your own thinking. We'll tell you when AI is encouraged throughout the selection process. Misrepresentation at any stage may result in removal from consideration for this and future roles.
  

**How We Review Applications** We use AI throughout our hiring process to help review, screen, schedule interviews, and assess applications. These tools support our team's review; they do not replace it, and every hiring decision is made by a person.

 Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join the Reliability Engineering team that operates a bare\-metal Kubernetes platform across multiple metro locations. The platform's architecture is defined and the build is underway you will provision and operate it day to day: bringing up nodes and clusters, running upgrades, keeping the fleet consistent through GitOps, and owning your shift of the on\-call rotation.
   

  

 This is a deliberately broad role. We are not looking for someone who works one layer and hands everything below it across a boundary. You will work alongside the teams that own the physical hardware, the underlay network, and the data plane software, and you need working knowledge of all three enough to isolate where a problem lives before escalating it.
   

  

 You will join the Digital Interconnection Engineering organization. The team owns the full application stack for interconnection and the Kubernetes platform for the software\-defined data plane across multiple metros. We operate with an automation\-first, GitOps\-driven culture and a strong commitment to operational rigor, documented runbooks, and blameless postmortems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 OS Provisioning \& Bare\-Metal Infrastructure
   

  

* Provision bare\-metal servers across multiple metros using the team's PXE/iPXE imaging and cloud\-init pipeline, and harden the OS prior to cluster bootstrap
* Extend and maintain that provisioning automation as new hardware, metros and OS versions are introduced, keeping node bring\-up free of manual per\-node steps
* Work with the teams that own the hardware on BIOS/firmware baselines, NIC configuration and disk layout standards, and use BMC/IPMI and platform sensors to isolate hardware faults before handing them over


 Kubernetes Cluster Operations
   

  

* Bring up and operate Kubernetes clusters following the team's established control\-plane topology, including etcd members, kube\-apiserver HA behind the L4 load balancer or VIP, and defined failure\-domain placement
* Provision worker nodes, configure CNI, and run end\-to\-end cluster validation before workloads are onboarded
* Perform routine cluster operations: node drains and replacements, certificate rotation, capacity checks, and remediation of cluster\-level alerts


 GitOps \& Fleet Configuration
   

  

* Make cluster and fleet configuration changes through GitOps, keeping clusters consistent, auditable and drift\-free
* Perform cluster registration, RBAC and policy changes in the management plane, respecting the isolation between production and nonproduction planes
* Extend the deployment pipeline for the software\-defined data plane adding validation coverage and test cases working from the pipeline design and gates owned by the senior engineers on the team


 Upgrades \& Patching
   

  

* Execute rolling OS and Kubernetes upgrades across the fleet from tested runbooks, with no unplanned downtime, and improve those runbooks as you find gaps
* Take etcd snapshots ahead of significant changes, and run scheduled restore drills to prove the recovery path works
* Apply the platform's patching cadence across the fleet, tracking CVEs affecting the OS, Kubernetes and cluster components


 Observability \& On\-Call
   

  

* Own your shift of a follow\-the\-sun on\-call rotation, and act as first responder for control\-plane, node, and cluster\-level incidents
* Build and tune dashboards and alerts for the systems you operate, and reduce alert noise where it is costing the rotation time
* Write up incidents you respond to, contribute to blameless postmortems, and turn recurring toil into automation
* Author and maintain runbooks for the components you operate


 What Success Looks Like First 9\-12 Months
   

  

* Provisioning and bringing up nodes and clusters independently, without per\-node manual steps
* Running OS and Kubernetes upgrades on cadence from runbooks, and improving those runbooks where they fall short
* Owning your on\-call shift unassisted, as first responder for cluster and node\-level incidents
* Restore drills run on schedule, with the recovery path demonstrated rather than assumed
* Measurable reduction in toil or alert noise in the areas you operate
* Runbooks and dashboards in place for the components you own


**Qualifications**
 Required
   

  

* Linux on bare metal: Solid hands\-on Linux/Ubuntu administration and provisioning; familiarity with PXE/iPXE imaging or equivalent, cloudinit, and OS hardening
* Hardware working knowledge: Comfortable with BMC/IPMI consoles, SMART data and platform sensors; able to identify a failing disk, NIC, DIMM or power supply and follow a vendor replacement process
* Kubernetes: Production experience operating clusters ideally RKE2 or kubeadm on bare metal including etcd basics, node lifecycle, CNI configuration and cluster\-level troubleshooting
* Infrastructure as code: Day\-to\-day use of Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, Fleet or similar; comfortable making infrastructure changes through a pipeline rather than by hand
* Networking: Working knowledge of VLANs, BGP, bonded NICs and SR\-IOV enough to read a configuration, interpret what you see, and isolate whether a problem is above or below the network layer
* Upgrades: Experience executing OS and Kubernetes upgrades in production against an established runbook
* On\-call: Experience in an on\-call operations role, responding to production incidents and writing them up afterward
* Automation mindset: A reflex to automate repeated manual work, and to leave the runbook better than you found it


**Preferred**
* Experience with Rancher, Rancher Prime or a comparable multi\-cluster management plane
* Familiarity with DPDK\-based data planes such as 6WIND VSR, or with SR\-IOV NIC tuning
* Exposure to SDN or private\-connectivity platforms (Equinix Fabric, VyOS, or equivalent)

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Principal Data Engineer**

**About the Role**


We are seeking a highly experienced **Principal Data Engineer** to lead the design, architecture, and implementation of enterprise\-scale data platforms that power Takeda's R\&D, Clinical, Regulatory, Commercial, and Enterprise Analytics ecosystems.


As a technical leader, you will drive the strategic direction of data engineering, define architecture standards, and deliver scalable, secure, and compliant data solutions using **Databricks, AWS, PySpark, Delta Lake, and modern DataOps practices**. You will partner with business stakeholders, solution architects, product owners, data scientists, and engineering teams to build reliable data products that accelerate innovation and data\-driven decision making across Takeda.


This role requires deep expertise in modern cloud data platforms, distributed data processing, software engineering practices, and cross\-functional leadership. You will mentor engineering teams, establish best practices, and ensure enterprise data solutions meet quality, scalability, security, and regulatory requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Architecture \& Platform Leadership**

* Lead architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise data platforms on Databricks and AWS.
* Define and govern enterprise data engineering standards, reference architectures, and reusable frameworks.
* Design scalable Lakehouse architectures using Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Workflows, and AWS cloud services.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Drive platform modernization initiatives, cloud migration programs, and data transformation roadmaps.
* Establish best practices for data modeling, metadata management, data lineage, and governance.

title: Solution Category Owner – Consultation Solutions
description:
**ZEISS in India**

ZEISS in India is headquartered in Bengaluru and present in the fields of Industrial Quality Solutions, Research Microscopy Solutions, Medical Technology, Vision Care and Sports \& Cine Optics.


ZEISS India has 3 production facilities, R\&D center, Global IT services and about 40 Sales \& Service offices in almost all Tier I and Tier II cities in India. With 2200\+ employees and continued investments over 25 years in India, ZEISS’ success story in India is continuing at a rapid pace.


Further information at ZEISS India .


The role encompasses a broad range of responsibilities aimed at delivering innovative, high\-quality software consultation solutions across hardware, software, and digital platforms:


**Portfolio Strategy \& Category Ownership in alignment with overall department structure**

* Define and own the multi\-year Consultations strategy, aligned with the company's vision care growth objectives and competitive positioning, explicitly covering In\-Store Consultation categories.
* Establish and maintain the category roadmap, covering device\-agnostic consultation workflows that guide ECPs from anamnesis and measurement inputs to the appropriate consultation pathway and product recommendation, independent of the devices connected to the digital connectivity platform.
* Build on continuous market analysis, competitive benchmarking, and voice\-of\-customer research with ECPs and retail chains to identify white spaces, emerging technology trends, portfolio gaps and unmet needs in guided, measurement\-driven consultation workflows.

**Product development oversight in alignment with overall department structure**

* Provide indirect leadership to product development teams, aligning development priorities with category strategy and working closely with the Product Development team to reinforce the product vision, ensuring portfolio investments deliver competitive, market\-ready solutions.
* Own the business requirements and commercial specifications that inform product development and engineering; represent the market perspective throughout the development lifecycle (concept through launch), ensuring clear and testable requirements are defined in close collaboration with Product Owners.
* Define business and workflow requirements that enable consultation guidance based on consumer anamnesis, device\-sourced measurement data and workflow stage, ensuring the solution can recommend the right consultation path regardless of the measurement devices used in the store.
* Serve as senior sponsor for key development programs within the refraction category, ensuring cross\-functional alignment and timely escalation of risks.
* Champion design\-for\-configurability, total cost of ownership, and regulatory strategy considerations from the earliest stages of development.
* Ensure products are designed for serviceability (ease to install, configure, upgrade), partnering with Service/Operations to incorporate field feedback early.
* Ensure products are designed to be secure, including cyber security and data privacy requirements, working with relevant security/compliance stakeholders across the lifecycle.

**Product lifecycle management in alignment with overall department structure**

* Own the full device lifecycle from concept and market entry through growth, maturity, and end\-of\-life planning.
* Define launch strategies in partnership with Marketing, Sales, and regional teams, including go\-to\-market approach, pricing, positioning, and key opinion leader engagement.
* Monitor post\-launch performance against defined KPIs (revenue, margin, market share, customer satisfaction) and drive corrective actions where needed.
* Continuously validate post\-launch whether the solution improves ECP guidance quality, consultation pathway selection, workflow consistency and consumer conversion across different device setups and store environments.
* Plan and execute product refresh, extension, and phase\-out decisions, managing inventory implications in conjunction with Supply Chain and Finance.

**Team leadership \& people management**

* Directly recruit, develop, and manage a team of Product Managers responsible for product implementation across geographies and customer segments.
* Set clear objectives, provide regular feedback, and build individual development plans that grow product management capability within the team.
* Foster a high\-performance culture grounded in customer focus, analytical rigor, and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Act as an indirect leader and integrating force for the extended cross\-functional team – including product development engineers, supply chain managers, regulatory specialists, and clinical affairs – ensuring shared ownership of category outcomes.

**Cross\-functional collaboration \& stakeholder management**

* Serve as the primary interface between the Consultations category and global functions including Product Development, Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, Marketing, and Sales.
* Partner with device, connectivity platform, clinical, workflow and UX stakeholders to ensure measurement data from different in\-store devices can be translated into meaningful consultation guidance for ECPs.
* Partner with Regulatory Affairs to ensure all Consultation Software Solutions in the portfolio are developed and maintained in compliance with applicable requirements (FDA, EU MDR, ISO 10937, and relevant national standards).
* Collaborate with Clinical Affairs to define clinical evidence requirements and support generation of data that strengthens the clinical and commercial position of the portfolio.
* Present category strategy, portfolio performance, and investment cases to executive leadership and governance bodies.

**Education / Professional Certification**

Preferred level of education (unskilled/vocational training/bachelor/university degree); preferred Institutes if any.


* Degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, or a related technical/scientific discipline; MBA or equivalent business qualification is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 7\- 10 years of progressive experience in product management, portfolio management, or category leadership within medical/ophthalmic devices or vision care.
* Proven track record owning and growing a product portfolio across the full lifecycle (sourcing, development oversight, launch and lifecycle optimization).
* Leadership experience managing Product Managers and influencing senior stakeholders in a global matrix organization.
* International launch experience across multiple geographies (e.g., EMEA, APAC, Americas) is preferred.
* Experience defining or managing digital workflow solutions that use anamnesis and measurement data to support clinical or commercial decision guidance, ideally in device\-agnostic retail or healthcare environments.

**Knowledge / Skills / Other characteristics**

* Strong analytical and financial acumen; able to build business cases, manage P\&L\-related metrics and use data to drive decisions.
* Solid understanding of regulatory pathways and quality systems relevant to ophthalmic devices (e.g., FDA 510(k), EU MDR, ISO standards; ISO 13485\).
* Excellent communication and executive stakeholder management; able to present strategy and performance to senior leadership and engage clinical stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of ECP consultation workflows, including how anamnesis, measurement data, device interoperability and workflow context can be translated into guided consultation recommendations.
* Fluent in English; additional languages are an asset.

**Preferred experience**

* Direct experience with refraction, centration, visual acuity testing, or ophthalmic diagnostic device categories and consultation software.
* Familiarity with integrated refraction, centration workflow platforms and digital health solutions for eye care professionals.
* Familiarity with device\-agnostic data integration concepts and consultation decision\-support workflows that guide ECPs through the consumer journey from anamnesis to recommendation.
* Experience engaging with eye care professionals (ECPs), optometrists, and ophthalmologists as primary customers or stakeholders.
* International product launch experience across multiple geographies including EMEA, APAC, or Americas.
* Experience in a global matrix organization with cross\-cultural team leadership.

title: Principal Engineer, Systems
description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.


We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.


Vantive: A New Company Built on Our Legacy


Since last year, Baxter has been on a journey to separate our Kidney Care segment into a standalone company. Vantive\* will build on our nearly 70\-year legacy in acute therapies and home and in\-center dialysis to provide best\-in\-class care to the people we serve. We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us.

  

 At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us are driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us as we revolutionize kidney care and other vital organ support.

 **JOB TITLE: Principal Engineer, Systems (Model based development)**

**Your role :**


As a MDB leader for the Peritoneal dialysis systems the candidate will lead the development of embedded control software for complex electromechanical medical devices using a Model‑Based Design (MBD) approach. In this role, you will lead the design, simulation, and implementation of control algorithms using MATLAB/Simulink, ensuring robust system behavior and seamless integration with hardware components.


You will be responsible for generating high‑quality embedded code through automated workflows, ensuring compliance with relevant software and medical device standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 60601, and internal quality processes. Working within the Systems Engineering team and collaborating closely with Software, Hardware, V\&V, Quality, Regulatory, and Manufacturing groups, you will help translate system‑level requirements into validated models and embedded implementations.


The ideal candidate possesses strong analytical skills, deep experience in MBD workflows, and a solid understanding of real‑time embedded systems. You demonstrate leadership in guiding technical decisions, ensuring design traceability, performing system analysis, managing interfaces, and delivering solutions that support safe, reliable, and innovative medical devices.

 **Job description :**


As a MDB leader for the Peritoneal dialysis systems the candidate will lead all the MBD activities collaborating with the cross functional teams to deliver the embedded code while meeting all the medical device regulations and standards with Aqueduct as the leading project.

* Define and own the MBD framework, methodology, and governance for MATLAB/Simulink, State flow, and Embedded Coder.
* Create system‑level models (plant \+ controller) for electro‑mechanical behaviors—motors/actuators, power stages, sensors, safety interlocks, calibration, and diagnostics.
* Define modeling guidelines, libraries, and reference architectures to maximize reuse, traceability, and testability.

Translate system requirements into executable models; maintain end‑to‑end traceability (DOORS Simulink Requirements tests* code).
* Decompose control strategies and safety requirements into model components, interfaces, and state machines.
* Lead FMEA /Risk analysis (ISO 14971\) and ensure design mitigations are implemented and verified in models.
* Set standards for auto‑code generation (Embedded Coder, coder profiles, build settings, data types, fixed‑point).
* Ensure generated C/C\+\+ integrates cleanly with target RTOS/MCU/SoC, HAL/BSP, drivers (SPI, I2C, UART, PWM, ADC, timers), and communication stacks (CAN, Ethernet if applicable).
* Enforce coding standards (e.g., MISRA‑C/C\+\+), static analysis, and defensively designed runtime checks.
* Establish model‑in‑the‑loop (MIL), software‑in‑the‑loop (SIL), processor‑in‑the‑loop (PIL), and hardware‑in‑the‑loop (HIL) strategies, including plant models for electromechanical dynamics.
* Own model coverage, requirement coverage, and code coverage targets; define acceptance criteria and entry/exit gates.
* Implement CI/CD for models and generated code, including automated builds, checks, and regression tests.
* Ensure compliance with IEC 62304 (software lifecycle), IEC 60601 (applicable electrical safety), ISO 14971 (risk), ISO 13485 (QMS), and FDA design controls.
* Lead and author deliverables: software plans, architectures, risk controls, verification protocols/reports, trace matrices, and problem reports/CAPA inputs.
* Partner with Cybersecurity (FDA guidance, SBOM, vulnerability handling) and Usability Engineering (IEC 62366\) where SW behavior impacts user risk.
* Work with Electrical/Mechanical to co‑simulate and co‑design plant models (motors, gear trains, loads, sensors, thermal, power).
* Support manufacturing test strategies (boundary tests, calibration models, digital twins) and service diagnostics.
* Guide suppliers/CMs on MBD integration and compliance expectations; review artifacts from external modeling partners.
* Mentor systems, software, and test engineers in MBD, control theory, and verification strategies.
* Drive continuous improvement—templates, scripts, libraries, checkers, and dashboards; conduct design and model reviews.
* Serve as the technical authority for trade‑offs (performance vs. safety vs. cost vs. schedule).

 **Qualifications \& Experience**

**Education**

* Master’s in Electronics and communication, Electrical and Electronics, Automation or Computers engineering or a similar field.

 **Experience \& Expertise**

* 15 years of relevant industrial experience in model based development.
* Exposure to coding standards and SW development life cycle
* Expertise in design control documentation, including Design History Files.
* Proven experience in technical risk assessment, mitigation, and execution.
* Strong analytical skills, and trouble shooting experience in electro\-mechanical devices.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and business decisions at all organizational levels.

title: System Development Engineer II, TFS-Onboarding
description:

---------------


Are you passionate about solving complex financial automation challenges at scale? Amazon's Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) team is seeking a System Development Engineer II to help revolutionize how we manage financial operations across our global transportation network. In this role, you'll build critical automation solutions that streamline migrations, generate actionable metrics, and enable seamless financial book closures for one of the world's most sophisticated logistics operations.  

  

You'll work at the intersection of software development and financial systems, creating tools and mechanisms that address real customer challenges. Your solutions will empower teams across transportation finance to work more efficiently, make data\-driven decisions faster, and adopt new features with confidence. This is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on systems that process financial data at Amazon's scale while growing your technical expertise in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.

Build and maintain reporting infrastructure that enables accurate and timely financial book closures, collaborating with finance teams to understand requirements

Your day begins by addressing critical tickets from finance teams, investigating root causes and implementing fixes. You'll spend time enabling new reporting capabilities for upcoming book closures, collaborating with stakeholders to ensure accuracy. Throughout the day, you'll participate in code reviews, share knowledge with teammates, and contribute to the team's operational excellence.

The Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) team plays a crucial role in Amazon's logistics ecosystem, building and maintaining the financial systems that power our global transportation network. We're a collaborative team of engineers and analysts who value creative problem\-solving and continuous learning. Our mission is to provide reliable, scalable financial tools that help transportation teams operate efficiently and make informed decisions.  

  

We foster an environment where curiosity thrives and knowledge\-sharing is part of our daily routine.
